prompt:
A line-art multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 5 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 13 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a clean, simple line drawing: uniform thin black outlines on a plain white background, with no shading, hatching, grey tones, colour or texture. Each panel has a thin black border, with plain white gutters between the panels. Location: 灵堂, Day, cool daylight through the tall left windows and a flat fluorescent wash.
Image 1: the character sheet of 司辛 (50)
Image 2: the character sheet of 张翠梅 (55)
Image 3: the character sheet of 司念 (18), look S0
Image 4: the location 灵堂, with no people
Draw each character so they can be told apart as in their reference image: the hairstyle, build and outfit in outline. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location image only for the layout of the space and the place of its furniture and props, drawn in outline. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location image, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Funeral hall. The axis runs from the mourners to the bier. The camera stays on the window side, the bier at screen right, the mourners facing screen right. There is one bier at the screen-right end under one white cloth, with one framed portrait above it. Paper wreaths stand along both walls and the double wooden doors are behind the mourners at screen left. Si Yi stands at the head of the bier facing screen left, off frame in this segment. Si Nian lies still under the white cloth in burial clothes, feet toward the mourners. Si Xin stands in the front row nearest the camera with Zhang Cuimei at his far side, both facing the bier, ready to bow. Bin Ke Jia and Bin Ke Yi stand in the back row, off frame.
Panel 1: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level from the window side. Si Xin and Zhang Cuimei stand in the front row facing the bier at screen right and begin to bow; Si Yi is off screen.
Panel 2: Close-up insert, locked-off camera, eye-level at the foot of the bier. Si Nian's foot in a black cloth slipper, at the edge of the white cloth, twitches once.
Panel 3: Close-up, low angle from the window side. Si Xin freezes halfway into his bow, his eyes widening behind his glasses, fixed on the bier.
Panel 4: Medium two-shot, handheld, eye-level from the window side. Si Xin grabs Zhang Cuimei's sleeve in panic and pulls her toward him.
Panel 5: Medium close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level from the window side. Zhang Cuimei shakes his hand off her sleeve and rolls her eyes.
Panel 6: Wide shot, high angle from the window side, bier at screen right. The front row bows again toward the white-draped bier where Si Nian lies; Si Yi is off screen.
Panel 7: Extreme close-up insert, high angle on the bier. The back of Si Nian's hand with the red string bracelet rests on the white cloth, and her fingers flex.
Panel 8: Medium shot, handheld, eye-level from the window side. Si Xin jolts upright with a shudder and slaps Zhang Cuimei's arm with his palm.
Panel 9: Close-up, quick push in, eye-level from the window side. Si Xin's face is pale and sweating, his glasses slipping down his nose.
Panel 10: Medium close-up, low angle from the window side. Zhang Cuimei glances back at the staring guests, flushes and tugs at her black armband.
Panel 11: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level from the window side. Si Xin and Zhang Cuimei stiffly bend into the third bow toward the bier; Si Yi is off screen.
Panel 12: Medium shot, low angle from the foot of the bier, window side. Si Nian sits bolt upright on the bier with her eyes still shut, the white cloth sliding to her waist, and she frowns in annoyance.
Panel 13: Wide shot, handheld, high angle from the window side, bier at screen right. Mourners scatter toward the walls, Zhang Cuimei falls backward onto the terrazzo floor, and Si Xin stumbles back a step while Si Nian sits upright on the bier.
Keep the characters, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no photographic rendering, shading or colour.
